    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 0 and (r, c) not in seen:
                stack = [(r, c)]
                seen.add((r, c))
                cells = []
                while stack:
                    y, x = stack.pop()
                    cells.append((y, x))
                    for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 0 and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((yy, xx))
                            stack.append((yy, xx))
                components.append(cells)
    if components:
        counts = [sum(grid[r][c] == 9 for r, c in cells) for cells in components]
        for r, c in components[counts.index(min(counts))]:
            grid[r][c] = 0
